text:
alana: Quick kickoff for cloud catalog offers 15-min sync. Need to finalize AWS/GCP/Azure offer ids, trial duration, and images this sprint. Who can own offerId mapping?

diego: I'll take offerId mapping for AWS + GCP. Not familiar with Azure private offers schema though.

faye: I can handle Azure planId mapping and the storefront copy. Also will create concise feature bullets (3).

alana: Perfect. Trial duration proposal: 14 days for marketplace trial SKU, align with legal?

legal-bot: automated-check: 14-day consumer trial passes regional constraints. Flag: ensure data-retention text included in listing.

asset-bot: image-check: AWS hero must be <1MB, 1:1.5 recommended. Upload assets to /drive/marketplace/1755.

tom: Staging items: publisher staging accounts provisioned; deploy 301 on staging. Docs: docs/marketplace/staging-301.md. I609

faye: I'll upload Azure plan manifest + three CTAs: "Try free 14d", "Start trial", "Contact sales". Prefers Try free 14d.

diego: Uploading spreadsheet with cloud mappings. Also renaming internal RED-BETA to RED-BETA-LEGACY to avoid collisions.
alana: Action list: diego (AWS/GCP offer ids), faye (Azure plan + copy + images), tom (verify staging deploy), legal to sign EULA snippet after faye edits. Preflight Tue 10am PT. Thanks all :raised_hands:
